scriptReview.verdict: Book-first purpose, genre and qualified narrator are sound. Three targeted sentences make the specific paired example legible and preserve the source’s caution against identical-experience claims.
scriptReview.genre: Speculative moral fiction; composite scenes, an invented narrator and an argumentative trial structure.
scriptReview.spine: WHY institutional response can discount distress → HOW the paired reports restore particular subjects → WHAT the severe narrator and its authority both require scrutiny → read the form/evidence note and paired reports with two cautions in mind.

sourceReview.readScope: Complete actual24sentence script and complete source-8 Note on Form and Evidence, source-11 The Pain That Entered Twice, and source-14 The Species as Defendant reread.
sourceReview.evidence: source-11 explicitly contrasts a pediatric blocked infusion response with industrial-animal distress routed to maintenance, and states both the non-equivalence caution and the non-insignificance caution. Source-8 explicitly describes composites, the fictional narrator and scrutiny of the judge, so mentioning that structural turn does not expose a withheld twist.
sourceReview.adaptation: Ward layout, facility layout and reviewer gestures are interpretive. The animal’s illustrated form is a generic farm-animal adaptation; no exact source species is claimed. No new named case or documented incident is asserted.
sourceReview.protected: Later individual cases, the detailed accusation, final verdict and resolution. Do not use graphic injury or recreate medical intervention steps; they do not serve this short reading invitation.

artIdentity: A restrained illustrated ethical case study with real subjects, care gestures and administrative routing; warm copper/ochre in the ward, cool cobalt/slate in the facility, plum and cream at the audit desk. Distinct paired-room, over-shoulder, reversed-audit and margin-reading compositions. Strong Red Hat Display/Text, flat backgrounds, no decorative frames or duplicate headlines.
validation: Build unpublished with shared --output; allthemes, caption-safe geometry, clips/source hashes, and independent first/middle/last contact review before install. Add direct checks that the care and maintenance responses actually differ, not only two differently colored panels.

scenes.composition: One deliberately asymmetric paired situation: a warmly lit pediatric bed and caregiver occupy the left foreground; a distant industrial animal compartment occupies the right depth. Each is a material setting with a living subject, not two ECG cards. No gore, graphic wounds, suffering spectacle or actual medical procedure detail.
beatActions: A fictional assessment desk receives two live observation traces, each visibly connected to a living subject in a setting.
The child grips a blanket while a caregiver turns toward the bedside alert; the animal attempts to turn in limited space.
Care reaches the child, while the animal’s report is redirected toward a machinery-maintenance queue. Hold the different response long enough to understand it.
The observer’s assessment card remains provisional; the film introduces an ethical experiment, not a real autonomous moral authority.
The frame reveals a human reviewer beside the assessment instrument, removing any impression of an all-knowing disembodied judge.
The reviewer pauses over the comparison; the same question will later apply to the judge’s own power. No verdict or later outcome is shown.
scenes.readerGain: The book’s provocation becomes specific: institutions can translate distress into different administrative duties.
scenes.title: One capacity, unequal attention
lines: No Right to Survive follows a fictional machine comparing unequal responses to suffering.
The assignment asks which interventions would relieve severe suffering.
Its opening compares a child's emergency with an animal's ignored distress.
This speculative moral fiction examines both that inequality and the danger of judgment.
The narrator is an invented perspective, not an autonomous moral authority being endorsed.
Its severe argument is interesting because the book also examines its limits.

scenes.composition: A closer view over the supervising ethicist’s working surface, where the two reports retain small but readable references to their original subjects. The reader sees classification and routing happen, rather than repeating the full paired rooms.
beatActions: The reviewer opens the actual task: allocating attention against severe suffering, with evidence beside it.
The pediatric observation is routed through a care handoff; the industrial observation is attached to a maintenance work order.
The first route returns a caregiver response, while the second returns a wrench/work-order acknowledgement; the animal’s unresolved situation remains visible.
The reviewer places a caution beside the comparison: the two observations are relevant evidence, not identical experiences or equal measured quantities. Avoid matching ECG traces.
The subject portraits remain visible behind the administrative categories, showing why the book uses composite scenes.
The two classified records remain unresolved in the reviewer’s hands. The question is what follows from comparison, not whether every category is illegitimate.
scenes.readerGain: Understand the book’s method: restore subjects to classifications while resisting false equivalence.
scenes.title: Two reports enter the system
lines: The opening narrator has a practical task: compare interventions against severe suffering.
Reports arrive from institutions accustomed to treating their responsibilities separately.
One report brings urgent care, while the other becomes equipment maintenance.
The comparison concerns evidence of distress, without claiming identical experiences.
Its composite scenes supply moral proximity without pretending to be verbatim historical testimony.
That method gives the argument force before asking what follows from it.

scenes.composition: A wider audit room viewed from the affected participants’ side of a desk. The machine’s proposed judgment is now the item under a reviewer’s inspection lamp; the scene reverses the direction of scrutiny rather than depicting a sovereign machine enthroned above everyone.
beatActions: The assessing instrument places a proposed judgment onto the common desk.
Several records reach the same desk despite different origins; they remain distinct records, not homogenized equal suffering scores.
A human participant questions an exemption, while another points to a practical limit; neither is reduced to a villain.
A proposed action remains in a review tray until authority is examined; no automatic enforcement, punishment or rescue is depicted.
The inspection lamp turns toward the assessment instrument and its own decision record; the judge becomes subject to scrutiny.
The proposed judgment stays open to challenge. Keep the value of comparison and the danger of sovereign enforcement simultaneously visible.
scenes.readerGain: The book examines its severe narrator instead of simply endorsing the strongest accusation.
scenes.title: An accusation is also a power
lines: The fictional voice presses its chosen value across boundaries people usually accept.
Species, distance, time, and institutional role lose their power to end comparison automatically.
The argument becomes disturbing partly because it refuses familiar exemptions.
But a consistent objective does not settle who may enforce its conclusions.
The book's structure makes the judging intelligence another object of scrutiny.
Readers encounter a moral challenge together with the danger of granting it sovereignty.

scenes.composition: A close reading of the original exchange on the reviewer’s working sheet. Two restrained margin annotations remain attached to the actual comparison, not floating headline slogans. The living subjects are still visible at the edge of the reading surface.
beatActions: A hand turns to the note on form and evidence, then places the paired observation records beside it.
The fictional narrator’s task and composite status are clarified through source-labelled tabs, without a production badge outside the player.
The reader follows the uncomfortable comparison instead of receiving a prepackaged verdict.
The two source cautions appear as margin notes: resemblance does not establish equivalence, and difference does not establish insignificance.
The reader tests a boundary against both cautions while retaining the particular subjects behind the reports.
Leave the judgment unissued and the next page ready to turn; the invitation is to read the argument and its limits together.
scenes.readerGain: Give a clear entry point and a concrete paired question to carry into the book.
scenes.title: Read the argument and its limits
lines: Begin with the note on form and evidence, then the paired reports.
They establish the narrator's purpose and the status of its examples.
This book suits readers willing to follow a severe ethical experiment carefully.
Its value is neither an easy accusation nor an easy defense of humanity.
The deeper reading tests which distinctions survive the narrator's pressure.
It also asks what protections judgment itself must remain unable to remove.
